articles.title: Drunk Duo’s Road Ruckus in Sonbhadra After Crash Caught on Camera, Both Detained
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A high-voltage drama unfolded on a road in Sonbhadra district after a car accident involving an allegedly drunk youth and woman, with a viral video of the incident drawing widespread attention.

body.html:
A high-voltage drama unfolded on a road in Sonbhadra district after a car accident involving an allegedly drunk youth and woman, with a viral video of the incident drawing widespread attention.

The incident occurred in Dibulganj under the Anpara police station area when a Swift car travelling from Renukut to Anpara collided with an unknown vehicle. The car was badly damaged in the crash, though both occupants escaped without serious injuries.

According to locals, both the youth and woman in the car were under the influence of alcohol. After the collision, they stepped out and created a ruckus in the middle of the road, leading to a heated argument with passersby.

As a crowd gathered and began recording the incident on mobile phones, the woman reportedly became aggressive and objected to being filmed, further escalating the situation. The commotion led to temporary disruption of traffic in the area.

Police reached the spot upon receiving information and detained both individuals. The driver is said to be a resident of the Sasan region in Madhya Pradesh.

A video of the incident has since gone viral on social media. Police said a case has been registered and further investigation is underway.

#Sonbhadra #UttarPradesh #BreakingNews #RoadRage #DrunkDriving

articles.title: Hyderabad: Daughter, Lover Kill Mother, Bury Body at Home; Crime Cracked After Bike Sale
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking murder case has come to light in Jawaharnagar, Hyderabad, where a woman was allegedly killed by her minor daughter and her boyfriend, and buried inside their house.

body.html:
A shocking murder case has come to light in Jawaharnagar, Hyderabad, where a woman was allegedly killed by her minor daughter and her boyfriend, and buried inside their house. The crime, committed nearly a year ago, was uncovered after a suspicious attempt to sell the victim’s two-wheeler.

The deceased has been identified as Anju (around 40–45), who lived with her daughters in Bharat Nagar under Jawaharnagar police station limits in Medchal district.

According to police, the accused daughter, Ishika, was in a relationship with Mountie Rajput alias Monti Kumar Singh (22), a driver. Anju had opposed the relationship and had earlier filed complaints against the youth, leading to his arrest twice.

Police said that on May 12, 2025, the accused, then a minor, along with her boyfriend, allegedly stabbed Anju to death inside their house. The body was initially hidden under a bed and later buried within the house premises by covering it with cement.

To avoid suspicion, the accused continued to pretend that her mother was missing. On October 12, 2025, she filed a missing person complaint at Jawaharnagar police station. Despite investigation, the case remained unsolved for nearly a year.

During this period, the accused also reportedly accessed ₹80,000 from a chit fund in her mother’s name and later married her boyfriend in January 2026 at Yadagirigutta.

The case took a turn when the accuse’s boyfriend attempted to sell Anju’s two-wheeler in Ramkothi. The shop owner grew suspicious due to inconsistent statements and alerted police. During verification, it was found that the vehicle was registered in the name of a missing woman.

Police then detained and questioned the accused, during which the boyfriend allegedly confessed to the murder. A clues team conducted excavation at the house, confirming the crime.

Police have taken Mountie Rajput into custody, while the minor girl has been sent to a State Home. Further investigation is underway.

The incident has triggered outrage among locals, who have demanded strict action against the accused.

#Hyderabad #Telangana #BreakingNews #MurderCase #CrimeNews

articles.title: Tragedy at Barh Station: Man Hit by Vande Bharat While Spitting Tobacco, Dies During Treatment
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A passenger died after being hit by a speeding Vande Bharat train at Barh railway station near Patna on Tuesday, in an incident attributed to negligence. The deceased has been identified as Mithilesh Yadav, a resident of Lalpur village under Bhadaur police station limits.

body.html:
A passenger died after being hit by a speeding Vande Bharat train at Barh railway station near Patna on Tuesday, in an incident attributed to negligence.

The deceased has been identified as Mithilesh Yadav, a resident of Lalpur village under Bhadaur police station limits. He had reportedly come to the station to board a train.

Accident on Track
According to eyewitnesses, Yadav stepped down from platform number two onto the railway track near pole number 480 on the down line to spit tobacco. At the same time, the Patna–Howrah Vande Bharat train was passing at high speed.

Unable to notice the approaching train, he was struck and sustained critical injuries.

Treatment and Death
The incident caused panic at the station. Railway Police reached the spot and rushed the घायल to a nearby hospital. After initial treatment, he was referred to Patna due to his critical condition but succumbed to injuries during treatment.

Police Statement
Railway Police SI Virendra Prasad said that prima facie the incident appears to be a case of negligence, as the passenger failed to notice the oncoming train.

The body has been sent for post-mortem, and further investigation is underway.

Safety Advisory
Railway authorities have reiterated their appeal to passengers not to step onto tracks or cross railway lines, warning that such negligence can lead to fatal accidents.

#Bihar #Patna #Barh #VandeBharat #RailwayAccident

articles.title: 7 Months After Burial, Man’s Body Exhumed in Hapur on Court Orders; Wife Named in Murder Case
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a significant development from Hapur district, Uttar Pradesh, the body of a man buried seven months ago was exhumed in Mohammadpur Rustampur village following orders from the Allahabad High Court for a fresh post-mortem.

body.html:
In a significant development from Hapur district, Uttar Pradesh, the body of a man buried seven months ago was exhumed in Mohammadpur Rustampur village following orders from the Allahabad High Court for a fresh post-mortem.

Police and administrative officials were present during the exhumation, which was carried out amid allegations by the family that the death was a case of murder.

The deceased, identified as Arish Ali (32), had died under suspicious circumstances on August 7, 2025, just months after his marriage to Rahima. At the time, his body was found inside a room in a blood-soaked condition, with a firearm reportedly recovered from the scene. He was later declared dead at a hospital in Meerut.

Initially, the circumstances surrounding the death remained unclear and the body was buried. However, the family later approached the court seeking justice, alleging that Arish was shot dead by his wife.

Acting on the family’s plea, the High Court ordered the exhumation and a second post-mortem to ascertain the exact cause of death.

Murder Case and Absconding Accused
Based on complaints by the deceased’s mother, Falaknaaz, a murder case was registered against Rahima on August 18, 2025—ten days after the incident. The family alleged that Rahima was unhappy with the marriage, frequently quarrelled, and demanded separation.

Following the registration of the case, the accused and her family members reportedly went absconding and switched off their phones. Police said efforts are ongoing to trace and arrest her.

Delay and Local Protest
The family also alleged initial inaction by police despite multiple complaints. The FIR was registered only after intervention by senior officers. The delay triggered anger among villagers, who organised protests and a candle march demanding justice and the arrest of the accused.

Ongoing Investigation
CO Garhmukteshwar Varun Mishra said the case is under investigation and all evidence is being examined. The fresh post-mortem report is expected to play a crucial role in determining the course of further action.

Authorities stated that necessary legal steps will be taken based on the findings.

#Hapur #UttarPradesh #BreakingNews #MurderCase #Exhumation

articles.title: Eid Turns Tragic: 11-Year-Old Crushed by Tractor-Trolley in Greater Noida, Driver Absconds
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: An 11-year-old girl lost her life after being run over by an out-of-control tractor-trolley in Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh, in an incident captured on CCTV. The accident occurred around 11 am on Monday (23 March 2026) in Aliwardipur village under the Ecotech-3 police station area.

body.html:
An 11-year-old girl lost her life after being run over by an out-of-control tractor-trolley in Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh, in an incident captured on CCTV.

The accident occurred around 11 am on Monday (23 March 2026) in Aliwardipur village under the Ecotech-3 police station area. The victim, identified as Alafiya, had come with her mother and sister to her aunt’s house to celebrate Eid.

According to police, Alafiya was playing with her cousin Tooba in a narrow lane outside the house when a tractor-trolley loaded with construction material, stationed behind a dumper, suddenly moved forward. The driver allegedly lost control and rammed into the area where the children were walking.

Alafiya was crushed under the wheels of the vehicle and sustained critical injuries. She was rushed to a nearby hospital, where doctors declared her dead on arrival. Her cousin Tooba was also trapped under the tractor but escaped without injuries.

The driver fled the scene, abandoning the vehicle. Police reached the spot after receiving information, took the body into custody, and sent it for post-mortem. The tractor-trolley has been seized.

Ecotech-3 SHO Ajay Kumar said an FIR has been registered based on a complaint by the victim’s family, and efforts are underway to trace and arrest the absconding driver.

Family members said Alafiya was a student in Ghaziabad and had come to celebrate the festival. Her death has left the family devastated, turning a festive occasion into mourning.

#GreaterNoida #UttarPradesh #RoadAccident #BreakingNews #CCTV

articles.title: Clash Inside Chandaka Police Station: 13 Arrested in Bhubaneswar Family Property Dispute,
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A violent clash between two groups inside Chandaka Police Station in Bhubaneswar has led to the arrest of 13 persons, while a video of the incident has gone viral, raising serious concerns over security within a police facility.

body.html:
A violent clash between two groups inside Chandaka Police Station in Bhubaneswar has led to the arrest of 13 persons, while a video of the incident has gone viral, raising serious concerns over security within a police facility.

The incident took place on March 21 and is linked to a long-standing property dispute in the family of hotel owner Pitabas Paltasingh. The conflict involves the son of his first wife and the children of his second wife, who have reportedly been at odds for several years.

According to reports, the dispute initially escalated outside the police station, where members of both groups allegedly engaged in a physical altercation and attacked each other with weapons. The situation then spilled into the police station premises, where the clash continued in the presence of police personnel.

At the time of the incident, only two constables and a duty officer were present, with no senior Officer on duty, raising questions about security and response capacity.

Police later clarified that at around 11:19 pm, an injured man, Soumyaranjan Paltasingh, entered the station with his wife, already bleeding from injuries sustained earlier in the village clash. Within seconds, members of the rival group also arrived, leading to a heated argument that escalated into pushing and scuffling.

Officials stated that police personnel intervened promptly and brought the situation under control within about 30 seconds. They also clarified, based on verified CCTV footage, that no stabbing or knife attack took place inside the police station, and no weapons were used within the premises. The blood seen in the video was due to injuries sustained earlier.

However, the viral video shows members of both groups brawling inside the station, which has triggered public criticism and debate over law enforcement lapses.

Police registered two FIRs in connection with the case and arrested 13 individuals, including women and members from both sides of the family. The accused include the man, his two wives, their sons, and other relatives. Following rejection of their bail pleas, all have been remanded to judicial custody.

Police sources indicated that the family had a history of disputes, and similar incidents had required intervention earlier. Authorities are continuing their investigation into the case and examining all aspects, including prior clashes.

#Bhubaneswar #Odisha #PoliceStation #BreakingNews #PropertyDispute

articles.title: High-Speed Crash in Mainpuri: Car Rams Police Bike, Constable Thrown 20 Metres; 3 Injured
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A major accident was reported in Uttar Pradesh’s Mainpuri district after a speeding car rammed into a police motorcycle, leaving three people injured, including a constable. CCTV footage of the incident has also surfaced.

body.html:
A major accident was reported in Uttar Pradesh’s Mainpuri district after a speeding car rammed into a police motorcycle, leaving three people injured, including a constable. CCTV footage of the incident has also surfaced.

The incident occurred on Monday in the Bhogaon police station area, following a clash between two groups over an old election rivalry and a dispute from the previous day. According to police, Naman Shakya and his associate Chhotu Chauhan were at a petrol pump when another group, including Pankaj, Chandraprakash, Ajay, and Bhanu, arrived, leading to a heated argument and physical altercation.

Upon receiving information, a Cobra police team reached the spot. Constable Jatin Kumar was riding the police bike, with Constable Vineet as pillion.

During the chaos, Naman Shakya allegedly attempted to flee the scene in his car. In panic, he sped off at high speed, lost control of the vehicle, and crashed directly into the police motorcycle.

Eyewitnesses said the impact was so severe that Constable Jatin Kumar was thrown nearly 20 metres along with the bike, while Constable Vineet narrowly escaped serious injury. The car then veered off and crashed into a roadside shop, Sadhna Box Industry, on GT Road.

Two civilians present at the shop, Sadhna Devi and her daughter Priya, also sustained injuries in the crash.

All the injured were rushed to a nearby hospital for treatment. Police have taken Naman Shakya and Chhotu Chauhan into custody. Two motorcycles linked to the accused involved in the earlier altercation have also been seized.

Police said a search is underway to trace other accused involved in the clash, and further investigation is in progress.

#Mainpuri #UttarPradesh #RoadAccident #BreakingNews #PoliceInjury

articles.title: ‘Murder Victim’ Found Alive: Kaushambi Woman Traced to Haryana, Husband Freed After Month in Jail
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a dramatic turn of events in Uttar Pradesh’s Kaushambi district, a woman who was allegedly murdered has been found alive in Haryana, leading to the release of her husband who had spent nearly a month in jail in connection with the case.

body.html:
In a dramatic turn of events in Uttar Pradesh’s Kaushambi district, a woman who was allegedly murdered has been found alive in Haryana, leading to the release of her husband who had spent nearly a month in jail in connection with the case.

Superintendent of Police Rajesh Kumar said on Tuesday that the woman, identified as Ankita, was traced to a rented accommodation in Manesar, Gurugram, where she was living with her cousin, Ramu alias Sankalp Mishra. Police have brought her back to Kaushambi for further legal proceedings.

Case Background
Ankita, married to Raju Tiwari for around 10 years, had gone missing from her in-laws’ home in Alwara village under the Mahewaghat police station area on January 21, 2026. A missing person complaint was filed the following day with the consent of her family.

However, on February 20, her parents accused her husband and in-laws of murdering her and disposing of the body. Following the allegations, Raju Tiwari surrendered in court on February 27 and had been in judicial custody since then.

Investigation and Recovery
During the investigation, police tracked the location of Sankalp Mishra, with whom the woman had reportedly been in contact earlier. Surveillance led the police team to Manesar, where they kept watch for four days before locating the woman.

According to police, Ankita initially remained silent but later stated that she was living with the man of her own free will.

Legal Action
Following her recovery, the court ordered the release of her husband, who had been jailed based on the earlier allegations. Police have now registered a case against four individuals, including the woman’s father, for allegedly filing a false complaint and misleading investigators. Two accused have been arrested.

Officials said the woman’s statement is being recorded before the court, and medical examination formalities are underway.

The incident has raised serious concerns over misuse of legal provisions and the consequences of false allegations, which led to the incarceration of an innocent person.

#Kaushambi #UttarPradesh #BreakingNews #FalseCase #PoliceInvestigation

articles.title: Lift ‘Free-Fall’ Scare in Gurugram Society: Priest Injured, Residents Allege Repeated Negligence
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A priest was injured after a lift malfunction in a residential society in Gurugram, Haryana, triggering panic among residents and raising concerns over maintenance standards.

body.html:
A priest was injured after a lift malfunction in a residential society in Gurugram, Haryana, triggering panic among residents and raising concerns over maintenance standards.

The incident occurred at Paras Irene Society in Sector 70A, where the lift reportedly dropped suddenly from an upper floor while the priest was inside. CCTV footage from inside the elevator shows the cabin jerking sharply and descending rapidly, causing glass panels inside to shatter.

The priest, who was alone in the lift at the time, sustained injuries to his head and body. After the lift reached the ground floor and doors opened, residents rushed him to a nearby hospital, where he is currently undergoing treatment.

Residents alleged that this is not the first such incident in the society. They claimed multiple complaints about lift malfunctions had been raised earlier, but no effective action was taken by the management.

The incident has left residents concerned, with many expressing fear over using the elevators, especially for children and elderly family members.

Experts note that complete free-fall in modern elevators is extremely rare due to built-in safety mechanisms. However, sudden drops or abrupt descents can occur due to technical faults or poor maintenance.

Authorities are yet to issue an official statement on the incident. Residents have demanded a thorough inspection of all lifts in the society and strict action against those responsible.

#Gurugram #LiftAccident #BreakingNews #Haryana #PublicSafety

articles.title: Bulandshahr LPG Dealer Alleges Harassment, Forced Apology; Hindu Raksha Dal Leader Arrested
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: An LPG dealership owner in Bulandshahr, Uttar Pradesh, has alleged that he was harassed, subjected to communal abuse, and forced to publicly apologise by members of the Hindu Raksha Dal after asking them to follow queue rules at his agency.

body.html:
An LPG dealership owner in Bulandshahr, Uttar Pradesh, has alleged that he was harassed, subjected to communal abuse, and forced to publicly apologise by members of the Hindu Raksha Dal after asking them to follow queue rules at his agency.

The incident occurred on Tuesday, March 17, when Khalid, who operates a liquefied petroleum gas agency, insisted that customers stand in line and collect cylinders only after prior booking. The measure was reportedly implemented amid increased demand due to fears of a supply shortage linked to the ongoing West Asia conflict.

According to Khalid, a group of Hindu Raksha Dal members objected to standing in the queue. One of them allegedly contacted the organisation’s leader, Neetu Yadav, who asked Khalid to allow them to bypass the line. When he refused, Yadav reportedly warned that he would come to the spot.

A video of the incident, which has circulated widely on social media, shows Yadav and others confronting Khalid outside the agency and allegedly using communal slurs. Khalid stated that he was forced out of his shop and made to apologise publicly.

“They said this is a Hindu Rashtra and that they would not let it become Bangladesh,” Khalid alleged, adding that he was compelled to fold his hands and repeat an apology, assuring he would not enforce such rules again.

Khalid, who has been running the dealership for nearly a decade and serves around 24,000 customers in nearby villages, said he had never faced such an incident before. He noted that the area, though Hindu-majority, has traditionally witnessed peaceful coexistence between communities.

Police took suo motu cognisance of the matter and registered a case at Khurja Nagar police station. Hindu Raksha Dal leader Neetu Yadav has been arrested, and further legal proceedings are underway.

#Bulandshahr #UttarPradesh #BreakingNews #CommunalTension
